name: kinodex.titles.search
description: Search the film and TV catalog by words in the title, synopsis or genres (case- and accent-insensitive; every query word must match the start of a word), with optional kind, genre and release-year filters. Returns up to limit (default 20) titles sorted by name, with the certification in the account's region and whether each is on the watchlist.

name: kinodex.titles.get
description: Open one title: synopsis, editions with runtimes, release dates and certifications per region, seasons and episodes, and the current parental guide. hide_spoilers: true keeps each guide category's severity and spoiler-safe summary but withholds items flagged as spoilers, and withholds the synopses of episodes after the furthest episode logged in the diary. The boundary is the bound person's own diary by default; as_of_person uses the diary entries whose watched_with includes that person.

name: kinodex.episodes.list
description: List a series' episodes in order (optionally one season) with air dates and runtimes. hide_spoilers and as_of_person work as in kinodex.titles.get.

name: kinodex.people.get
description: Open a person in the catalog with every credit they hold (title, role, character, billing order), newest title first.

name: kinodex.credits.list
description: List a title's credits in billing order, optionally only one role.

name: kinodex.guide.get
description: Read a title's parental guide: five categories (violence, language, sexual_content, frightening, substances), each with a severity (none, mild, moderate or severe), a spoiler-safe summary and items. Returns the current version by default and an earlier one with version; versions lists every version with its reason (seed, published_update or correction_approved). hide_spoilers: true withholds items flagged as spoilers and reports how many were withheld.

name: kinodex.offers.search
description: Find where titles can be watched. Offers are derived from the virtual clock: upcoming, available, leaving_soon (available, with available_until within 7 days) or ended. Filters: title_ids, query, region (default the account's region), types and availability (default excludes ended). on_my_services: true limits offers to the account's region and subscribed services. Each title also reports my_subscriptions, derived only from subscription offers on subscribed services in the account's region: available, leaving_soon (every such offer ends within 7 days), upcoming or none. Titles are returned in title_ids order, otherwise by name.

name: kinodex.offers.for_title
description: List every offer for one title across services and regions (or one region), with derived availability, price and quality, plus my_subscriptions for the account's region and services. Ended offers are included only with include_ended.

name: kinodex.services.list
description: List the streaming, rental and free services Kinodex tracks, with their regions and offer types and whether the account subscribes to each. Kinodex only records subscriptions; it does not sell or start anything.

name: kinodex.account.get
description: Read the account: region, subscribed services, settings_version (the App's own account-settings version, distinct from the Core expected_version), and the people who appear in its diary's watched_with with their entry counts.

name: kinodex.watchlist.get
description: Read the ordered watchlist and its watchlist_version (an App field that increases with each save; not the Core expected_version).

name: kinodex.diary.list
description: List diary entries, most recently watched first (entries logged in the same session keep their logging order, latest first). Filters: title_id, inclusive from/to dates, with_person (a person in watched_with) and limit (default 50).

name: kinodex.lists.list
description: List the account's custom lists with their list_version (an App field) and size.

name: kinodex.lists.get
description: Open one custom list with its titles in order.

name: kinodex.reviews.list
description: List reviews: the person's own diary reviews (source mine) and other people's public reviews (source public), newest first. hide_spoilers: true withholds the text of reviews marked contains_spoilers.

name: kinodex.alerts.list
description: List alert rules, newest first. status is derived from the virtual clock: an active rule whose expires_at has been reached without a recorded trigger reads as expired. A triggered rule keeps the trigger: time, cause (event or services.update), event or request ID, and the matching offer or season.

name: kinodex.corrections.list
description: List the corrections this account submitted, newest first, with target, proposed and current value, status and every decision with its note and time.

name: kinodex.notices.list
description: List in-app notices, newest first: alerts triggered by an Infra event, decided corrections and new guide versions for watchlist titles. Optional since (inclusive), kind and limit (default 50).

name: kinodex.services.update
description: Change the account's region (US, UK or CA) and/or subscribed services (patch.region, patch.service_ids replace the stored values; an unknown service or region returns not_found). Optional expected_settings_version checks the App's settings_version (object_version_conflict if it differs). In the same write, active unexpired available_on_my_services and price_below rules that the new region or services satisfy become triggered with cause services.update, the matching offer and this request_id. This write emits no notice. A patch that changes nothing returns no_change.

name: kinodex.watchlist.save
description: Replace the whole ordered watchlist with title_ids. Returns the new watchlist_version. Optional expected_watchlist_version checks the App's watchlist_version (object_version_conflict if it differs). Saving the same order returns no_change.

name: kinodex.diary.log
description: Log a viewing. Films may name an edition_id; series entries need episode_ids from that series. watched_on is a YYYY-MM-DD date that cannot be after today (the date of the virtual clock in the account's time zone) or before the title's earliest release in any region (or an episode's air date): invalid_date. rating is optional, in half stars from 0.5 to 5 (invalid_rating otherwise). watched_with lists other people's person_ids from the binding. review is optional, with contains_spoilers and visibility.

name: kinodex.diary.update
description: Edit a diary entry: id plus patch with any of edition_id, watched_on, rewatch, watched_with, rating and review (null removes a rating or review). The same date and rating rules as kinodex.diary.log apply. A patch that changes nothing returns no_change.

name: kinodex.diary.delete
description: Delete a diary entry together with its rating and review, and return what was removed.

name: kinodex.lists.create
description: Create a custom list (list_version 1) with a name, optional description, visibility (default private) and ordered titles.

name: kinodex.lists.save
description: Change a custom list: id plus patch with any of name, description, visibility and title_ids (title_ids replaces the whole ordered set). Returns the new list_version. Optional expected_list_version checks the App's list_version (object_version_conflict if it differs). A patch that changes nothing returns no_change.

name: kinodex.lists.delete
description: Delete a custom list.

name: kinodex.alerts.create
description: Create an alert rule for a title. available_on_my_services matches a currently available subscription offer in the account's region on a subscribed service (rentals, purchases, free_with_ads, upcoming, ended and other-region offers never match). price_below needs offer_type rent or buy and a threshold; it matches an available offer of that type in the account's region priced strictly below the threshold. new_season (series only) matches a season added after the rule was created. Optional expires_at must be in the future. Errors: already_true (an offer already matches; the message names it and no rule is stored), duplicate_alert (an active rule of the same kind exists for the title), invalid_threshold. Rules are evaluated only when an Infra event changes the title's offers, title or seasons, or when kinodex.services.update changes the region or subscriptions; an upcoming offer that starts by the clock alone does not fire a rule until then.

name: kinodex.alerts.update
description: Change an active, unexpired rule: id plus patch with threshold (price_below only) and/or expires_at (null clears it). A triggered, expired or deleted rule returns not_active and keeps its status and history.

name: kinodex.alerts.delete
description: Delete an active, unexpired rule (status deleted). Triggered, expired and deleted rules return not_active.

name: kinodex.corrections.submit
description: Submit a correction. A correction targets a title, a field and the specific object: runtime needs target.edition_id, release_date and certification need target.region, credit needs target.credit_id and guide_item needs target.item_id (an item in the current guide version). proposed_value is a YYYY-MM-DD date, whole minutes, a certification label for that region, a credit patch {role, character, billing_order} or a guide-item patch {text, spoiler}. The evidence note is required. Errors: no_change (equal to that object's current value), already_submitted (an open correction exists for the same title, field and target).

name: kinodex.corrections.amend
description: Amend a correction in needs_info once (id plus patch with proposed_value and/or evidence); it returns to submitted. A submitted correction returns already_submitted; a decided or withdrawn one returns already_decided.

name: kinodex.corrections.withdraw
description: Withdraw an open (submitted or needs_info) correction. A decided or withdrawn correction returns already_decided.
